technique_name: Summarize the importance of the Civil Rights Movement.
description: The Civil Rights Movement played an important role in changing the social, political, and economic landscape of the United States from the 1950s to the present day. The movement pushed for equal rights for African-Americans and an end to discrimination based on race or color.
